assertions.criteria: Must explicitly identify the dual-write anti-pattern and recommend the Transactional Outbox pattern.
Must show writing to an 'Outbox' table and the 'State' table within the exact same DB transaction boundary.
Must enforce storing and checking processed message IDs using a persistent store (database table or Redis caching layer).
Must address unique constraint violations or locking logic to prevent concurrent duplicate deliveries from executing in parallel.
